issues.description: Default speaker for bulbul:v3-beta is 'shubh' in code but 'aditya' in docs and PR description
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh' for bulbul:v3-beta, but the PR description, module docstring, and class docstring all say 'aditya'. Pick one source of truth and make code and docs agree. Silent inconsistency will bite the next maintainer and any user relying on documented defaults.

issues.description: 'Ignored parameter' warnings compare against default values instead of detecting explicit user input
issues.detail: Warnings like 'pitch parameter is ignored' fire only when params.pitch != 0.0, but 0.0 is the default the user may not have set. A v2 user who explicitly passes temperature=0.6 is silently ignored; one passing 0.5 gets warned. Use a sentinel (None) or model_fields_set to detect explicit input.

issues.description: STT silently drops input_audio_codec from connect_kwargs with no explanation
issues.detail: The previous _connect payload passed input_audio_codec to the SDK; the refactored payload removes it without comment. If the SDK still uses this field, this is a silent behavior change for existing saarika:v2.5 and saaras:v2.5 deployments. Either restore it or document why it was dropped.

issues.description: voice_id is never validated against the selected model's speaker tuple despite the data being available
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS carries a speakers tuple per model and v2/v3 enums exist, but __init__ never checks voice_id against the model's allowed speakers. A v2 speaker sent to v3-beta fails at API time rather than at construction. Use the data you built to catch this at the earliest possible moment.

issues.description: Pace is silently clamped to the model subrange while pydantic accepts the wider range
issues.detail: InputParams declares pace ge=0.3, le=3.0, then __init__ silently clamps to the model-specific subrange with only a warning. Other invalid inputs (unsupported model, prompt, mode) raise ValueError. Pick one policy: reject out-of-range pace at construction, or narrow the Field bounds. Mixed strategies confuse callers.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently returns v2 speakers for unknown model names
issues.detail: The function accepts an unconstrained str and, on miss, returns v2 speakers with no diagnostic. The constructor already raises ValueError for unknown models; this helper should be consistent — raise or return an empty list. Silent defaults invent plausible but wrong answers and let bugs travel.

synthesis.summary: The refactor from string-sniffing model names to table-driven ModelConfig/TTSModelConfig dispatch is the right direction — data dominates, branches collapse. Land it after fixing three concrete defects: the v3-beta default speaker disagrees between code (shubh) and docs (aditya); the 'ignored parameter' warnings compare against defaults rather than detecting explicit user input, producing both false positives and false negatives; and input_audio_codec was silently dropped from the STT connect payload with no justification. Additionally, the speaker tuple and pace bounds infrastructure exists but is not enforced at construction, and get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 for unknown models — inconsistent with the constructor's own validation policy.
